title: Resource-based reliability of quantum-coherent devices
summary: Quantum devices can lose the resource needed for a specified function without entering a fixed failure subspace. We propose a resource-based reliability framework for this situation, quantifying the remaining task-relevant resource relative to a stated ideal capacity. The resource measure is selected through its operational connection to the task and the allowed operations. We develop this approach for a trusted quantum random-number generator and a calibrated two-port interferometer.
